scope: Writer closure for three frozen-prototype transfer cases, including the two authorized measured continuations. This does not overwrite initial comparisons or development records.

release_recommendation.action: Keep installed/published v1.10.0; do not release this prototype as a performance upgrade.
release_recommendation.basis: The fresh initial comparison and two bounded continuations do not demonstrate a substantial reusable detector-performance gain. All selected Human-class responses remain below 1%; one case selects its already eligible source. Editorial eligibility and small reader preferences do not establish the requested performance improvement.

counterpart_excerpt_exposure: Initial candidate files and first comparison were frozen before exposure. The released T01/T02 pair-feedback packages later exposed some counterpart quoted wording during a broad read. No baseline-output or blind-review files were opened by this writer. Later reads were projected to own aliases. The continuations are feedback-driven and not blind to the other arm; they must not be reported as untouched transfer.

review_limits.initial_review: Independent blind review was frozen before candidate measurement; this writer read only the released own-candidate reviews afterward.

review_limits.measurement: Experimental, independently uncalibrated four-class model response; not verified authorship probabilities, word fractions or quality ratings.
